baseline: Reconstruct original fresh_chain two actual six-goal Cases, finish both, settle A after B collection change, verify all P1-P5, preserve UUID/history/unchanged B.
api_cases: Three-way projection exact base/local/current, actual material v1->v2->v3; neither manual title nor hint changes facts.
KEEP then explicit continuation with fresh bound proof preserves exact human text and old history; no automatic ADOPT/VERIFY.
KEEP then legal EDIT produces a new manual revision; previous continuation proof must not silently authorize the new text (final contract decides renewal action).
ACCEPT uses exact untrimmed actual server source; MERGE uses explicit human supplied text and preserves original base/current history.
DEFER remains unresolved; UNKNOWN refuses edit/resolution/continuation; refresh and old success never resurrect eligibility.
Original affected P1 lock blocks editing/accept/merge/adoption as applicable; only original UNLOCK removes it.
Cross-Case/owner/tenant/role proofs and READ/PREPARE/EXECUTE/ACTIVE withdrawal remain denied before replay.
Actual source and note/card/plan ABA invalidate stale choices and continuation proof.
Same-key same-parameters replay, different-parameters conflict, lost receipt cold GET without POST; historical COMMITTED not current authority.
Proofless/foreign/stale continuation local ADOPT and replacement/template apply cannot bypass current note preservation gates.
html_execution: Full shipped HTML script, parsed button/form IDs and original installed wrappers, native HTTP -> ASGI -> isolated owned PostgreSQL. Mechanical DOM only. Original explicit opportunity refresh/preview, note choice, local ADOPT and actual REVIEW/CONFIRM/resource-link/reoffer/report/local commands then affected VERIFY and six-goal/worklist reads.
fixture_policy: New own fixture/mechanical driver may reuse original source helpers; never import an OUT-writing old fixture unchanged or modify its frozen directory. Copy mechanical setup when required, not product behavior.
evidence: Unique run IDs, literal expected/actual per Case, known and UNKNOWN separate, exact lock evidence only, raw failures retained, synthetic redaction sets 0600; final collection/JUnit/HTTP/flow/hash before-after once SHA freezes.
